mapper.sql: id, phase, started_time, finished_time, upserted, inserted, updated, removed, complete, error, add_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_cj_sync_run (phase, started_time, upserted, inserted, updated, removed, complete, error, add_time, update_time) values (#{phase}, #{startedTime}, coalesce(#{upserted}, 0), coalesce(#{inserted}, 0), coalesce(#{updated}, 0), coalesce(#{removed}, 0), coalesce(#{complete}, 0), #{error}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update litemall_cj_sync_run set finished_time = #{finishedTime}, upserted = coalesce(#{upserted}, upserted), inserted = coalesce(#{inserted}, inserted), updated = coalesce(#{updated}, updated), removed = coalesce(#{removed}, removed), complete = coalesce(#{complete}, complete), error = #{error}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from litemall_cj_sync_run where phase = #{phase} and complete = 1 order by started_time desc, id desc limit #{limit}
